fact: Equatorial Guinea is listed among the 49 countries that signed the Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence, done at Kigali on 4 April 2025 alongside the African Union and Smart Africa.

Equatorial Guinea was one of six countries whose delegations took part in the Second Lusophone Africa Data Governance Workshop in Luanda, 15-17 June 2026, hosted by Angola's data protection agency with Smart Africa, the World Bank, CETIC.br and UNESCO; the UNESCO article is dated 2026-07-28.

Equatorial Guinea currently chairs the rotating ECCAS presidency, and its Director General of Telecommunications, Celedonio Nguema Angono, spoke for it at the 19-20 October 2026 Brazzaville validation of the ECCAS Regional Data Governance Framework.

Equatorial Guinea was elected to chair the UN Statistical Commission for Africa (StatCom-Africa) for 2026-2028 at its tenth session in Addis Ababa, 19-23 October 2026, INEGE's director-general presiding, per INEGE; the agenda includes data as an economic asset and AI regulation in the public sector.
